He carried it up the spiral stairs, set it beside the logbook, and worked the cork free with patient fingers. Inside lay a single page, folded twice, its ink faded to the color of weak tea. The writing was not a plea, as he had expected, but a thank-you: for the light, for the steady sweep across black water on a night the writer had been certain would be their last. No name, no date. Elias read it twice, then pinned it above the lens, where every revolution would brush it with warmth. Outside, the sea answered nothing, and everything.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一只刚刚合上眼的巨兽，呼吸轻缓。街灯把柏油路染成湿润的橘色，偶有一辆出租车驶过，尾灯拖出一条长长的红线。便利店的玻璃门亮着，店员靠在柜台边打盹，关东煮的热气在冷空气里慢慢升腾。环卫工人推着车，扫帚划过落叶，沙沙作响。写字楼顶端还有几扇窗没有熄灯，像未愈合的伤口。天边泛起一点灰蓝，鸽子从屋檐下探出头。城市尚未醒来，却也不再完全睡着，介于梦与清醒之间，像一句说到一半的话。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by asking a smaller version of itself the same question.\n- Think of nesting dolls: open one, and inside is a smaller one that works the same way, until you reach the tiniest one that needs no opening.\n- Every recursion needs a stopping point, or it would go on forever like two mirrors facing each other."}
